decisive_items: right femoral aplasia and left femoral hypoplasia
Right unilateral cleft lip and palate
response.rationale: Femoral hypoplasia-unusual facies syndrome uniquely explains the combination of femoral aplasia/hypoplasia, cleft lip/palate, micrognathia, and contractures; oligohydramnios sequence and abruptio placentae-related growth restriction do not account for these specific skeletal and facial anomalies.

rejected.why: Oligohydramnios sequence causes deformations but not femoral aplasia/hypoplasia or cleft lip/palate; these are malformations, not deformations.
Abruptio placentae-related growth restriction explains low birth weight but not the specific congenital anomalies such as femoral aplasia and cleft lip/palate.
